shared_elements: shallow relief carving on pale tan stone
horizontal band of repeated small units
justification: Both show pale, weathered stone worked in low relief with repeated schematic motifs organised into at least one horizontal band, and both include profile bird-like shapes and small discs among the carved forms. The decisive difference is that A is an all-over grid of small, uniform, densely packed sign-like marks in strict horizontal rows, while B is a single vertical block dominated by a few large, boldly modelled animal figures arranged asymmetrically, so the compositional logic and scale of carving are quite unlike.
